reviews.text: Great pet store! Good prices. Local! I get all of my dog food here. Also great CBD calming treats for my dog Gemini.
This is an adorable little pet store with a great selection. Picked up some kitten food and a treat for my husky. Will definitely be coming back.

This is by far the best pet food store I have been to in the valley for my cat. They have a large selection of freeze dried treats, toys, cat harnesses and both wet and dry foods; all high quality and an affordable price. They were welcoming to me bringing my adventure cat in her backpack and I have never had a bad experience with the various employees there. Everyone has always wanted to talk about pets, what works for them and are forthcoming when asked any questions. I was sold as a loyal customer within a couple visits. As an added bonus, their rewards system also quickly adds up points!

absolutely love Noble Beast. It’s genuinely one of the few pet stores where the staff are not only incredibly knowledgeable, but consistently kind, patient, and willing to go the extra mile for both you and your pets. If they do not have a particular flavour or size of food in stock, they will happily special order it and even call you when it arrives, which is such a rare level of customer care these days.

What really sets them apart is how much they genuinely care about animal wellbeing. I’ve received thoughtful advice about elevated bowls to help my dog eat more comfortably, and they always take the time to answer questions without making you feel rushed. Their selection is fantastic for both dogs and cats.  Fresh treats, quality foods, toys, bowls, and supplies that are actually well curated rather than cheaply stocked. They also offer reward programs where free bags are earned over time, which makes supporting a local business even easier. You can tell this is a shop run by people who love animals just as much as their customers do.

I always support small businesses in Phoenix, and Noble Beast is one that I always return to when I’m in town. I like the selection and the prices, and I enjoy how I’m treated there.
This visit was different. My partner needed to use the restroom and a woman knocked loudly on the door and spoke to him in such a way we no longer felt welcome. This was a distressful event for us both, and he especially did not deserve that treatment. The cashier apologized on this woman’s behalf. But I’m not sure if I’ll be back after this.

Lol.... My momma left me and said she saw your store running errands. She told me that is was such a cute store. They take the time to truly introduce you to all they have 🧡!! My treats were yummy in my tummy 😋 …
Very clean, organized, and well-stocked store!

We really like this place. We have an elderly chihuahua that is missing teeth. She was having a hard time eating her dog food. She doesn’t like wet food. They recommended a freeze dry dog food and gave us samples of other kinds to try.  Our dog is addicted to the one they recommended and eats with no problem. It’s pricey (the specific food we need for her) but it’s the only food my dog can eat. I love that they have products you can’t find anywhere else for your pets. I also price checked the food and it’s similar to the prices I saw online, which lets me know they are being very fair! They are very friendly and knowledgeable.
A pleasant place, a variety of products, good service, spectacular.
“A perfect place to pamper your pet 🐾✨. A wide variety of products, excellent service, and a friendly atmosphere where your best friend feels right at home.” …
Stopped in while on vacation to get some little toy souvenirs for our cats. Super cool shop with something for everyone's furry friends.

Came here to find some novel protein food after my sweet cat started having some extreme GI reactions to her long-time food. Our vet recommended rabbit-based food, which Noble Beast had several options for in both wet and dry. The person tending the store was helpful and knowledgeable when I asked what they had available. I've since switched my patronage from Petsmart. This place is very much worth the cost!

Noble Beast Pet Supplies in Phoenix is a standout pet store experience, starting with a clean, well-organized environment that feels welcoming and easy to navigate; the staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely happy to help whether you’re searching for premium food, unique toys, or wellness items for your pet. The product quality is impressive, from high-end kibble to natural chews and specialty grooming supplies, and it’s clear they care about offering the best for pets. If you’re looking for a pet shop in Phoenix that offers both value and quality with excellent service, Noble Beast is a top-tier choice.
We appreciate your 5 star review!
Best place to buy your pet food for your cats, dogs, and chickens in the valley, hands down.
Thanks Lisa!
Thanks!
So nice and informative!! I asked 100 questions and the lady was so kind to answer all. They have tons of too quality food for my doggies
The Noble Beast is the best pet supply store! The staff and owners are amazing! We love them!
Always helpful, friendly and on point with their inventory. Highly recommend!!

I came here to get my dog's birthday treats....Such a cute place & it's local. Really nice staff. I'll definitely be back!

***update***

After my experience at Noble Beast yesterday, I think it's safe to say I'm going to be a loyal customer. The woman who helped me was beyond helpful & suggested a dog food over the phone for my fur baby that he actually seems to love & is healthier for him in his senior age. Thank you!!
Good selection for a smaller shop and friendly staff.
my friend gets her food here for her big dogs. I picked up her order that she called in. The nice man even put it in the truck for me. Geat Service. keep up the good work!
Very friendly and helpful staff....
I’ve been a big fan of this store since they first opened. It’s always been a safe, inclusive, and welcoming place to the community. There’s no other place I’d wish to shop of my cats and dog.

I love Noble Beast. I have shopped here for years and enjoy all of the employees. I bought a treat for my big dog and it didn’t work out. I was able to return it with no issues so that I could purchase something he would love. The owners have done an incredible job of creating a safe, welcoming space for customers and their pets!

I love the Noble Beast, they’re the best pet supply store in the area! The staff is so kind. Alison helped me out, showed me around the shop, and made sure I left with exactly what I needed for my puppy. I will always recommend this place to anyone with pets in Phoenix!
I love this store! I have a very anxious cattle dog and the associates here are wonderful at helping me pick out items for her! Thanks Noble Beast!

This pet store is amazing! The owner is the coolest lady ever! She is super flexible and friendly. You can tell the passion for animals is all around this store. Definitely go in if you can and support an amazing small business!

Worst experience EVER in any pet store. Owner was rude, talked over me, lied, called my dog "that dog", sales associate saw the interaction & was equally rude & refused to listen. BOTH were insulting & had zero compassion, listening & people skills. I wouldnt suggest this place to ANYONE. My dog & I were very traumatized when we left. I just read your reply. You are lying. I asked you to hold the harness while I tried yours on to which you yanked him hard alot & were no help  You claimed he bit you to which I didnt witness.  You kept saying I told you to touch him and I didn't say that either. I was trying to ask for help but you talked over me from the min I walked in. Yes we were so traumatized it was still on him as I felt threatened as did he to which your rude employee followed me out, I would have seen it in the car. Now you gaslight me more accusing me of trying to steal. How do you have a business. I could go anywhere and find better customer svc. Ridiculous to pin on me. You have NO business dealing with pets nor people.

This is an absolute joke.
1. overpriced
2. Rude employees(the younger girl)
3.they do not stick to their word.(the fact that they said they would take back the food if the dog didn't like it.) well they didn't. I heard the conversation. they agreed to take back the food in a trash bag. so Chris showed up with an air tight container and they didn't accept that. so they prefer a trash bag over a container.
4. the reply they just gave Christopher is an absolute joke.
Thank for the 5 star review Arianna. Glad you like our shop.
Oh No, sounds like you did not have the best experience. Sorry Cheri.
Super cute, small and local shop. Just wish they had more options for cats as they did for dogs.
Thanks!
Very friendly and helpful. I will keep shopping here.

Really unique pet store with a great selection of high-quality items you don’t see everywhere. The vibe is fun and interesting—definitely not your average chain store. Plenty of free parking, and the staff was super friendly and helpful.
Love it! Great nutritious options for your pets and very friendly and helpful staff. Also a great supply of leashes, toys, dental care items, etc.
Thanks for the love Lily!
Great pet store with lots of choices, but not a big box store, so, easy to shop in and get in and out quickly. Prices are reasonable too.
Thank you Dan!
We appreciate your 5 star review!
Fun people . Lots of pet stuff. Locally owned. Can't go wrong.
Great service, selection, easy parking, and awesome staff
Katie in particular was incredibly helpful.
Great items in stock, kind and helpful staff
I went in with the need to change my dog’s diet, they were very knowledgeable. My pups have been very happy with their suggestion.
A favorite! My pup and I love coming here. Great selection, prices, and staff
Thanks Daniel!
Excellent customer service and interesting products.
Great selection and knowledgeable staff

Lots of pet items in this small building.

My sibling comes here to buy dog food she can't get at the big box stores. I went there looking for a harness for my dog. The harness selection was very small, and I didn't find anything that met my needs. However, there is plenty of pet food here, lots of collars and  leashes,  and even a selection of little booties to protect your dog's feet from the hot Phoenix concrete.

The person working the  register was friendly.
Great eclectic pet store with good quality hand made pet stuff.
Great selection and friendly staff!
Great shop with a kind and helpful staff.  A really great selection of products, too.
